test_cases.name: 038_04_01 Create Inactive Context Source Registration Subscription
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create a context source registration subscription with isActive member set to false and it's initial status will be set to "paused"
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response containing:
        Response Header: Location containing ${registration_id} and
        Check Response Body containing an Attribute set to and
    Query Parameter: expected_attribute_name set to 'status' and
    Query Parameter: response_body set to 'response.json()' and
    Query Parameter: expected_attribute_value set to 'paused' and
        Response Status Code set to 201
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceSubscriptions/{subscription_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration Subscription with data: and
    Query Parameter: subscription id set to '${subscription_id}'
}
